caseName: Union Trust Co. v. Eastern Air Lines, Inc.
caseNameFull: Union Trust Co. v. Eastern Air Lines, Inc.

opinions.text: On consideration of the petition for rehearing, the order of December 5, 1955, ante, p. 907, is reopened and is modified by directing that the case be remanded to the Court of Appeals to permit that court to pass upon the several issues left undecided by our reversal of its judgment.
